children: UAE master developer Aldar and Mubadala Investment Company have acquired Masdar City Square, a commercial complex in Abu Dhabi, for AED 918 million ($250 million), through a JV established in 2024.
The latest acquisition includes over 47,000sqm of Grade A commercial space across seven buildings within the clean energry urban development located in the UAE capital.
Following the transaction, the JV now owns an AED 4.7 billion portfolio of commercial and residential assets in Masdar City.
The acquisition is the latest transaction under the JV, which also includes 17 assets within the Masdar City Green REIT and The Link, completed in Q1 2026.
(Writing by Bindu Rai, editing by Seban Scaria) bindu.rai@lseg.com

title: Aldar, Mubadala JV acquires Masdar City Square for $250mln
